comment: The sword as a standalone item: its own art, its own origin. Held by BORROWING a rig slot (see src/game/item.cpp), so it is a real rig Part while worn and severs, drops, burns and carves exactly like a limb. Regenerate with scripts/gen_sword_item.py — the edge block is emitted from the same constants that build the mesh, so the hitbox cannot drift from the art.
name: sword
